Routines

top source red_readhead_momfbd

SST pipeline

result = red_readhead_momfbd(fname [, version=string])

Return a fits-type header from a MOMFBD format file.

Return value

Parameters

fname in type=string

The name of the data file.

Keywords

version out optional type=string

The version of the momfbd (or redux) program that wrote the file.
